resources.string: The default schedule for all cars, parts, servicing and documents. You can choose a different schedule for an individual item.
Reminders are off for this schedule. Your service intervals and history stay available.
Local time on your phone. Android may deliver a reminder later to save battery.
Choose any days. “6 days” selects Monday to Saturday; you can change the selection.
By default, reminders start at the yellow level and repeat on the selected days until you record the work as done.
The yellow level comes from the item’s “Set the yellow level” settings; red means it is due. These settings change when reminders start, not the colours on the service card.
0 means at the level itself. With both distance and days set, the earlier one triggers a reminder. Distance uses estimated mileage; new odometer readings refine the estimate.
Repeat no more often than every … days
Repeats arrive only on the selected weekdays, at most once a day per item. Reaching yellow or red starts a new stage with a fresh count.
0 means no limit. The count starts over when you record the service as done.
Enter a whole number from %1$s to %2$s.
Could not save the reminders. Please try again.
Android has blocked notifications. The schedule can be saved, but reminders will only arrive after notifications are allowed.
